name: token burner
description: Proposal. Past 500k tokens the creature is on fire and running: the same head flames and alert visor, the back pair and the front pair of legs taking turns in a four phase run cycle with a one row bob, the body leaning a column forward over a ground line of embers that scrolls toward the back; every 1.5 s a hand catches fire, the arm thrusts with the fist white hot and a fireball flies off the edge, three forward from the right hand and one backward from the left after a four column surge; judge whether it reads as running and not as marching in place.
